verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for a payments API platform, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never mentions API keys, access keys, or permission scopes. The only related evidence covers Issuing card spend controls (granular limits, blocked industries, single-use virtual cards). Those are payment-card controls for cardholders, an adjacent feature rather than least-privilege API credentials for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
